name: Burns Electric

about:
Burns Electric, headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, has operated as an electrical utility contractor across the Midwest for more than 40 years. The company provides integrated construction, maintenance, and emergency services for power delivery infrastructure.

Its service portfolio spans overhead and underground distribution, transmission installation and maintenance from 69 kV to 345 kV, substation civil and electrical work, street and facility lighting, and 24/7 storm restoration. Crews handle most scopes in‑house and partner with specialists for turnkey projects.

The contractor serves investor‑owned utilities, municipal power agencies, and commercial customers needing distribution upgrades, pole replacements, feeder rebuilds, overhead‑to‑underground conversions, greenfield substations, and large‑scale LED streetlight replacements. Emergency response includes damage assessment, wire‑down monitoring, and logistical support.

Burns Electric emphasizes a safety‑first culture, holding a Veriforce A rating and a defined set of safety policies that prioritize public protection, property restoration, and team wellbeing. The firm positions its blend of advanced technology, experienced personnel, and solutions‑focused project management as its differentiator in the energy value chain.
